title: Pure Celtic Guard
summary: Pure Celtic Guard swarm and battle-draw strategy centered around Yugi Muto's iconic EARTH Warriors and the modern Celtic Guard of Noble Arms. Supported by Unexpected Dai, Heritage of the Chalice, and Noble Arms Equips, the deck empties its hand to trigger Noble Arms' direct attack and massive draw effects while fielding defensive Rank 4 Xyz.

summary.title: Starters
points: Unexpected Dai Special Summons the original Celtic Guardian directly from the Deck while you control no monsters, establishing a Celtic Guard name without your Normal Summon.
Heritage of the Chalice searches Celtic Guard of Noble Arms (treated as a Noble Arms card) directly from your Deck or adds it back from your GY.
Reinforcement of the Army searches any Level 4 Warrior starter, including Celtic Guard of Noble Arms or Obnoxious Celtic Guard.
Celtic Guard of Noble Arms Normal Summons and immediately Special Summons an additional Celtic Guard monster from your hand once per turn.

summary.title: Opening: Unexpected Dai + Heritage of the Chalice
steps: Activate Unexpected Dai with an empty field to Special Summon the Normal Monster Celtic Guardian from your Deck.
Activate Heritage of the Chalice to add Celtic Guard of Noble Arms from your Deck to your hand.
Normal Summon Celtic Guard of Noble Arms and activate its ignition effect to Special Summon an Obnoxious Celtic Guard (or another Celtic Guard) from your hand.
Equip Celtic Guard of Noble Arms with Noble Arms - Excaliburn or Noble Arms of Destiny to grant targeting or battle/destruction immunity and enable Morgan, the Enchantress of Avalon.
During the Battle Phase, attack with Celtic Guard of Noble Arms while your hand is empty to trigger its effect, drawing 1 card for every Celtic Guard monster you control.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Celtic Guard of Noble Arms can attack while your hand is empty, boasting 2100 ATK and drawing cards equal to your Celtic Guard count upon dealing battle damage.
Obnoxious Celtic Guard cannot be destroyed by battle with monsters having 1900 or more ATK, serving as an indestructible wall and permanent name for draw scaling.
Blade Armor Ninja detaches an Xyz Material to let Celtic Guard of Noble Arms attack twice, doubling its combat damage and potential draw triggers up to 6 cards.
Heroic Champion - Excalibur detaches 2 materials to surge to 4000 ATK, overpowering massive opposing bosses.
Ferocious Flame Swordsman boosts all Warrior monsters by 500 ATK and floats into a non-Link Warrior upon destruction.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Heritage of the Chalice searches Celtic Guard of Noble Arms or any Noble Arms Equip Spell, and recycles itself when an equipped Noble Arms monster is destroyed.
Noble Arms - Excaliburn prevents Celtic Guard of Noble Arms from being targeted by opponent card effects and fuels Morgan, the Enchantress of Avalon.
Noble Arms of Destiny protects a Celtic Guard from battle and effect destruction once per turn.
Morgan, the Enchantress of Avalon is a handtrap Quick Effect that negates any opponent card or effect by destroying one of your equipped Noble Arms cards.
Triggered Summon punishes opponent Special Summons by allowing both players to Special Summon a Level 4 or lower monster from hand, swarming another Celtic Guard on the opponent's turn.

main: Celtic Guard of Noble Arms
Once per turn Special Summons a Celtic Guard from hand, attacks when your hand is empty, and draws cards equal to the Celtic Guards you control when inflicting battle damage.
Obnoxious Celtic Guard
Cannot be destroyed by battle with any monster that has 1900 or more ATK, serving as an unbreakable wall and extra Celtic Guard name for Noble Arms' draw effect.
Celtic Guardian
Classic Level 4 EARTH Warrior Normal Monster summoned from the Deck via Unexpected Dai to boost Noble Arms' draw count.
Morgan, the Enchantress of Avalon
Quick Effect handtrap that negates an opponent's card activation while you control Celtic Guard of Noble Arms.
Heritage of the Chalice
Searches Celtic Guard of Noble Arms (which is always treated as a 'Noble Arms' card) from the Deck or GY.
Unexpected Dai
Summons Celtic Guardian from the Deck without using your Normal Summon.
Reinforcement of the Army
Searches Celtic Guard of Noble Arms or Obnoxious Celtic Guard.
Triggered Summon
Signature Trap that lets both players Special Summon a Level 4 or lower monster from their hand when an opponent Special Summons.
Noble Arms - Excaliburn
Equip Spell searchable by Heritage of the Chalice that makes Celtic Guard of Noble Arms untargetable and fuels Morgan.
Noble Arms of Destiny
Equip Spell that protects a Celtic Guard from being destroyed by battle or card effect once per turn.

Rank 4 Warrior Xyz that detaches 2 materials to reach 4000 ATK.
Rank 4 Warrior Xyz that grants Celtic Guard of Noble Arms a second attack, letting it draw up to 6 cards in one Battle Phase.
